sources.title: BiocharDS_V1.0
sources.license_status: CSV CC0 1.0 reported by NLM dataset catalog; workbook CC0 1.0 confirmed on official Springer Nature Figshare listing; re-check current artifact terms before redistribution.
sources.permitted_research_use: Exploratory and study-grouped meta-analysis only after source-key, treatment-arm, unit, and repeated-measure review.
limitations: Published descriptions report 2439 rows and 209 columns and refer to 367 source studies; these are metadata, not an independently audited sample count.
The full workbook's Reference and Explanation and unit sheets must be obtained and reconciled with the CSV before confirmatory grouped evaluation.
Biochar-plus-fertilizer versus untreated contrasts do not by themselves identify an incremental biochar effect or fertilizer substitution.

Published count discrepancy must be reconciled from the original files: the Nature HTML describes 2,439 rows and 209 columns; its article PDF abstract reports 2,438 items. The HTML also says 891 independent experiments including 700 under B and 314 under BF, whose subtotals sum to 1,014. Do not infer the correct counts or meanings without inspecting the exact CSV, workbook, and definitions.

sources.title: Sustained benefits of long-term biochar application for food security and climate change mitigation
sources.version: 2025 publication; supplementary version to be pinned on acquisition
sources.permitted_research_use: Longitudinal evidence and hypothesis stratification after artifact review, source crosswalk, and overlap reconciliation with BiocharDS.

limitations: Publisher says quality control is ongoing and future versions are expected.
